desc:
• DELICIOUS TASTE: Made with real cocoa, each box of crunchy lattice squares brings an irresistibly chocolatey taste your whole family can enjoy; Keep a box in your pantry for a morning food that's ready to eat any time

  • WHOLE GRAIN: Helps get your day off to a good start with 13g of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily)

  • GLUTEN FREE CEREAL: Pour some in a bowl with milk for a great-tasting, gluten free part of an easy breakfast; Pack some in a lunch box or backpack for snacks on the go; Add to homemade cereal bars as snacks for kids

  • VITAMINS AND MINERALS: Beyond the delicious taste, every serving is a good source of 12 vitamins and minerals, and made without high fructose corn syrup, or artificial flavors or colors

  • CONTAINS: One 12.8 oz box of Chocolate Flavored Chex Cereal
features:
Features

Gluten-Free: Made from whole grain rice and certified gluten-free, making it safe for individuals with gluten sensitivities or celiac disease.

Real Cocoa Flavor: Flavored with 100% real cocoa (processed with alkali) for a rich and authentic chocolate taste.

Whole Grain Goodness: Each serving provides 13 grams of whole grain, supporting a balanced diet.

No Artificial Colors or Flavors: Free from synthetic additives, offering a cleaner label.

No High-Fructose Corn Syrup: A healthier alternative to sugary cereals, especially for kids.

Fortified with Essential Nutrients: Includes 12 vitamins and minerals such as iron, calcium, vitamin D, and B-vitamins.

Kosher Certified: Suitable for a variety of dietary lifestyles. 

Benefits

Healthy Breakfast Option: Combines whole grains and essential nutrients for a balanced start to the day.

Kid-Approved Taste: Rich chocolate flavor makes it appealing to children, without overloading on sugar.

Versatile Use: Enjoy with milk, sprinkle over yogurt, or use in homemade snacks like chocolate Chex Mix or cereal bars.

Supports Bone and Energy Health: Thanks to calcium, vitamin D, and B-vitamins.

Diet-Friendly: Gluten-free and free from high-fructose corn syrup, fitting into various health-conscious diets.

Snackable Anytime: Works well as a dry snack or on-the-go bite—no milk needed.
ingredients: Whole Grain Rice, Rice, Sugar, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Salt, Molasses, Natural Flavor, Rosemary Extract. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Tricalcium Phosphate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
